name: Central Europe Political Atlas
version: v1.90 VAR Residual Dependence Attribution Research
stage: Validated Reduced-form VAR estimation; a preregistered attribution study finds the remaining residual dependence in the five formal country VARs weak and diffuse, concentrated in the 2020-2021 period with modest HICP seasonal dynamics, and not removed by diagnostic probes.
